OpenCode: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on OpenCode

No replay has run on OpenCode. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about OpenCode.

What the OpenCode setup page says about coverage

OpenCode decides which tools go through MCP. KYA gates the ones that do. A tool OpenCode executes outside MCP is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the OpenCode recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
